title: Faction
description: Galaxy-faction lore record (public/data/factions/*.json) — APP-OWNED, hand-authored GM-toolkit content. This schema is a CAPTURE of the existing contract (world-links D-WL1: schema + integrity only, no ingest, no shape change), derived from the field census of all 25 records (26 fields present on every record; 11 optional/legacy fields enumerated). These records are GALAXY factions — planet files carry their own planet-LOCAL faction instances (see planet.schema.json), which may point here via galaxy_faction_ref.
$comment: Value-level constraints are deliberately minimal (id/name/type enforced; prose and structured lore fields captured as-present). Tightening individual lore-field shapes is authoring-standards work, not data integrity — do it via its own ruled decision if ever needed. Integrity contracts enforced in validate_registries (world-links layer): (1) every faction id appears verbatim as a node id in schema/vocab/affiliations.vocab.json — the GM app resolves faction dossiers BY affiliation node id (gm:~1136), so a faction absent from the vocab silently breaks dossier lookup; (2) planet galaxy_faction_ref values (non-null) must resolve to these ids.

id.description: Stable id; the filename stem; the affiliations-vocab node id (id-identity convention).
